colors.strategy: The dynamic `accent_color` from the data MUST drive each palette uniquely. Do not hardcode a single theme. Apply the `accent_color` inline via style={{ color: accent_color }} or style={{ backgroundColor: accent_color }} for primary CTA buttons, icons, and highlights.

layouts.name: T1_Cinematic_Dark
layouts.best_for_trades: Luxury Landscaping, High-end Remodeling, Custom Home Builders
layouts.wow_element: Full-screen cinematic dark hero with deep gradients, overlapping masonry job gallery, glassmorphism floating bottom-nav for mobile.

section_by_section.header: Transparent, sticky. Becomes frosted glass (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`) on scroll. Mobile: Floating pill-shaped bottom nav.
section_by_section.hero: 100vh full-bleed image. Heavy gradient overlay `bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/50 to-transparent`. Text massive (text-5xl to 7xl), bottom-left aligned. The `accent_color` is used for a glowing scroll indicator.
section_by_section.how_it_works: Dark mode vertical timeline with glowing nodes colored by `accent_color`.
section_by_section.services: Large dark cards with edge-to-edge background images, heavily dimmed. On hover, image brightens and service details slide up.
section_by_section.why_us: Minimalist text over a dark grainy background, using massive numbers (01, 02) outlined in `accent_color`.
section_by_section.gallery: 3-column masonry grid (no gaps on desktop). High visual impact.
section_by_section.reviews: Single active review center-screen fading in/out, with stars in `accent_color`.
section_by_section.areas: Clean comma-separated list under a map silhouette.
section_by_section.form: Minimalist dark inputs (`bg-white/5 border-white/10`) with a glowing `accent_color` submit button.

layouts.name: T2_Urgent_Responder
layouts.best_for_trades: Towing, Emergency Plumbing, HVAC Repair, 24/7 Roadside
layouts.wow_element: Sticky pulsing 'Call Now' rail at the bottom, diagonal section cuts, continuous marquee of trust badges.

section_by_section.header: Top bar is a massive bold band featuring Trust Badges (Licensed/Insured) and a huge Phone Number. Uses `accent_color` as background.
section_by_section.hero: Diagonal bottom cut via `clip-path`. Left text container with high urgency copy. Right side is a cropped action image.
section_by_section.how_it_works: 3 massive bold numbered blocks stacked horizontally.
section_by_section.services: Accordion style. Saves space and forces users to the CTA faster. Clicking expands the price and description.
section_by_section.why_us: Marquee auto-scrolling row of benefits (e.g. 24/7 • Fast Response • Insured).
section_by_section.gallery: Horizontal scrolling carousel of action shots.
section_by_section.reviews: Grid of high-contrast cards (white on gray) with bold black text.
section_by_section.form: Embedded directly under the hero on mobile, sticky sidebar floating next to content on desktop.

layouts.name: T3_Modern_SaaS_Bento
layouts.best_for_trades: Junk Removal, Cleaning Services, Tech-Forward Handymen
layouts.wow_element: Left sidebar navigation (Desktop), strict Bento Grid mosaic for layout, horizontal scroll snap for 'How it Works'.

section_by_section.header: Desktop: Fixed left sidebar (250px wide) with navigation and CTA. Mobile: Top bar with hamburger.
section_by_section.hero: Crisp white background. Text left, stylized floating bento-box image right.
section_by_section.how_it_works: Horizontal swipeable cards on mobile, 3-column grid on desktop. `bg-gray-50`.
section_by_section.services: Clean minimalist grid, `shadow-sm`, border `border-gray-200`. Price is prominently displayed like a SaaS pricing tier.
section_by_section.why_us: Bento grid layout. One large square, two smaller rectangles. Distinctive and modern.
section_by_section.gallery: Square-cropped images inside a strict grid to maintain the bento aesthetic.
section_by_section.reviews: Clean white cards with gray borders, mimicking app store reviews.
section_by_section.form: Multi-step looking clean form, center screen, floating label inputs.

layouts.name: T4_Organic_Craftsman
layouts.wow_element: Editorial magazine typography, overlapping offset image blocks, soft rounded corners, warm earthy backgrounds.

section_by_section.header: Centered logo, navigation links flanking left/right. Soft and elegant.
section_by_section.hero: Padded container hero (not edge-to-edge full bleed), massive border-radius `rounded-[3rem]`. Text inside overlapping the image.
section_by_section.how_it_works: Vertical list with soft connecting lines. Numbers are large, overlapping serif fonts.
section_by_section.services: Alternating offset design. Row 1: Image left, text right (overlapping slightly). Row 2: Text left, image right.
section_by_section.why_us: Text wrapping around a central organic-shaped image.
section_by_section.gallery: Parallax scrolling staggered images (different heights and widths).
section_by_section.reviews: Large serif quotes in italics. Very editorial.
section_by_section.areas: Simple elegant text list separated by bullet points.
section_by_section.form: Integrated into a warm beige section. Inputs have bottom borders only (`border-b border-gray-400 bg-transparent`).

layouts.name: T5_Local_Trust
layouts.best_for_trades: General Contracting, Roofing, Established traditional businesses
layouts.wow_element: Centered hero with a massive floating 'Quick Quote' form embedded directly over the hero image bottom edge. Wavy section dividers.

section_by_section.header: Standard layout: Logo left, nav center, CTA right. Very familiar UX.
section_by_section.hero: Centered text over a darkened image. The bottom half contains a massive white floating card containing the Lead Form that overlaps into the next section.
section_by_section.how_it_works: Classic 3-column layout with circular icons taking the `accent_color`.
section_by_section.services: Zig-zag pattern (Image left/Text right, then Text left/Image right). Highly readable.
section_by_section.why_us: 2x2 grid of cards with prominent bold icons.
section_by_section.gallery: Large 'Before/After' style gallery with split layout.
section_by_section.reviews: Carousel of large, chunky testimonial cards with drop shadows.
section_by_section.form: Moved to the Hero. The footer simply contains a 'Call Us' massive banner.

visual_enhancers.T1_Cinematic_Dark: Use heavy noise/grain texture over the background. Ensure glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl` is used heavily on nav and cards.
visual_enhancers.T2_Urgent_Responder: Use `clip-path` for diagonal cuts. Use CSS animations for a pulsing 'Call Now' button. Implement `react-fast-marquee` for trust badges.
visual_enhancers.T3_Modern_SaaS_Bento: Use strict CSS grid (`grid-cols-4`, `grid-cols-8`). Ensure equal spacing (`gap-6`). Hover states should lift cards up `-translate-y-1`.
visual_enhancers.T4_Organic_Craftsman: Use negative margins (`-mt-12`, `-ml-8`) to create overlapping editorial layouts. Rely on Serif typography for numbers and quotes.
visual_enhancers.T5_Local_Trust: Use SVG wavy dividers between sections (`fill-white` or `fill-gray-50`). Floating elements must have standard `shadow-2xl`.

grids.bento_grid_protocol: For T3, ensure spans mix correctly: One big hero card `col-span-2 row-span-2`, flanked by smaller `col-span-1 row-span-1` widgets.
grids.masonry_grid_protocol: For T1 gallery, use CSS columns (`columns-1 md:columns-3 gap-4`) and `break-inside-avoid` on children to simulate masonry.

motion.framer_motion_usage: Wrap sections in simple scroll-reveal triggers. T1: Fade up. T2: Slide in from left/right (fast). T3: Scale up slightly. T4: Slow fade and slight rotation. T5: Standard slide up.
motion.micro_interactions: All buttons MUST have hover states. E.g., `hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the dynamic `accent_color` passes APCA contrast. If the accent is light, text ON the accent button must be black. If dark, white.
accessibility.focus_states: Add `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2` to all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing_ids: Every CTA, form input, and service card MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`).

media.image_constraints: Mobile hero images must not exceed 80vh to ensure text/forms are visible. Apply `object-cover` to all backgrounds.
media.hero_overlays: Never use flat opaque black. Use gradients: `bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent`.

image_urls.usage_instructions: Always attempt to render `data.photos` or `data.hero_photo` first. If null or empty, match the `data.business_type` to a fallback array above to ensure image-forward design.

instructions_to_main_agent.critical_directive_1: DO NOT create one generic layout and just change the colors/fonts. You MUST implement 5 completely separate component trees or highly conditional rendering blocks inside `ContractorSite.js`. The DOM structure, grid choices, and element ordering MUST be entirely distinct per template according to the layouts array.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical_directive_2: Use `lucide-react` for icons. Ensure icons inherit the `accent_color` where appropriate.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical_directive_3: Do not hardcode a single color. Use inline styles mapped to the data payload: `style={{ backgroundColor: data.accent_color }}` for buttons, and `style={{ color: data.accent_color }}` for text highlights.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical_directive_4: The provided layout designs are mobile-first. Ensure complex Desktop structures (like T3's Sidebar) collapse gracefully into Mobile (Top bar hamburger).
instructions_to_main_agent.critical_directive_5: Never leave transparent headers fully transparent without a blur if content scrolls under them. Use `backdrop-blur-md`.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Make these 5 templates truly structurally different.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Use proper image aspect ratios. No stretched imagery.
Do not use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Add solid colors or glassmorphism blur.
Never center-align the app container globally (`text-align: center`). Keep natural reading flow.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use real SVG icons.
